_comment: Config-driven fault injector. Each named fault is injected at ONE step (tool) per run. seed makes the 503-vs-timeout choice and the backoff jitter reproducible. Reasoning faults are produced by the scripted model (offline_scripts.py) and labelled ILLUSTRATIVE.

tool_drift.summary: tool renamed one argument; hint says which

tool_hard.summary: tool rejects even the renamed argument

reasoning.summary: model violates a rule once, fixes it after a corrective re-prompt

reasoning_stubborn.summary: model keeps violating the rule after every correction

permission.summary: 403: token lacks the scope for this tool

env_outage.summary: service down for the whole run
